required_gates.A1_MASTER_IDENTITY_CANONICAL: Exactly five MASTERs, all READY, exact Registry↔Manifest↔Canonical/Contract identity.
required_gates.A2_NEW_ROOM_RESTORE: All five MASTERs restore without chat-memory reconstruction.
required_gates.A3_CORE_DATA_HEALTH: No source with any CORE impact may be FAILED, STALE, MISSING or UNKNOWN.
required_gates.A4_SHARED_FACT_BOUNDARY: Shared Fact Vault HEALTHY, facts-only, no decision reconciliation, active-source coverage 100%, non-empty facts.
required_gates.A5_OFFICIAL_STATE_SAFETY: OFFICIAL latest/index valid, actual-run-only, no reconstruction, WATCH/provisional cannot become OFFICIAL.
required_gates.A6_WATCH_EVENT_SAFETY: MARKET/ALT1/ALT2 WATCH allowed, BTC/TRADING blocked, no execution fields, WATCH cannot mutate OFFICIAL.
required_gates.A7_FIVE_MASTER_E2E: All five pass isolated Fact→Bootstrap→OFFICIAL publish/history→WATCH allow/block→restore chain.
required_gates.A8_PRIVACY_AND_RESEARCH_SEPARATION: Public repo private trading state forbidden; BTC V2.6 production separated from V3.0 research.

warning_only_conditions.OPTIONAL_OR_CONTEXT_SOURCE_FAILURE: Warn but do not fail if no CORE impact is affected.
warning_only_conditions.SOURCE_HEALTH_OVERALL_DEGRADED: Allowed only when degradation comes exclusively from OPTIONAL/CONTEXT sources.
warning_only_conditions.NO_STORED_OFFICIAL_RUN: Valid state; must not be reconstructed.
